title: Event Organizer Member
place: Golden Code: Hackathon 2025 PUMA Information Systems
intro: Golden Code: Hackathon 2025 was a competition organized by PUMA Information Systems and the Faculty of Computer Science, in collaboration with UNITAR Malaysia to conduct a Business Plan competition. In this event, I contributed as a Event Organizer Member to event planning, coordination, and presentation activities to support smooth event execution.
jobdesk: Determined the event name, theme, and tagline to establish the overall concept and branding.
Created the event timeline and rundown to support structured event execution.
Prepared presentation materials used during the event.
Served as a timekeeper to ensure activities followed the planned schedule and timing.
